answer: A sybil farmer's edge is parallelism: one operator spins up identities like spray off an ocean wave. Break that edge with sequential work — a verifiable delay puzzle each identity must grind through alone, like tracing a single onyx thread through a vine: it cannot be split across machines or rushed by adding more. Within one epoch window, one operator can only finish a handful of puzzles, so a hundred fake identities simply run out of time, while a real agent finishing one on schedule looks exactly like itself.
